body:
§47.1 promises that under a `conflicts` binding policy a contested name is "a stated refusal
rather than a silent 404-shaped hole." Today that statement is made only to code — and for
cross-origin contests it is not even made to code: readContestedBindings
(src/gateway/registration.ts) reads ONE reactor, while a root-vs-channel contest is resolved in
replayRegistrationsImpl (src/gateway/lifecycle.ts), where interpretBindingPolicy's `.contested`
map is DISCARDED — only `.winners` is read. Under `conflicts` such a contest drops both
contenders silently: the exact 404-shaped hole §47.1 promises not to dig.

Build, in two halves — the gateway half is where the contest is retained; the server half only
renders (H6/H10: one resolver, surfaced, never re-derived):

1. Gateway: keep the contested reading across origins. Extend the replay fold to retain the
   `.contested` map it currently discards, composed with the single-reactor
   readContestedBindings rows, behind one gateway reading (extend readContestedBindings or add
   a sibling that aggregates root + pool rows exactly as replay composes them). Rows carry:
   lens name, entity, origin (root, or the channel name for a pool row — the same synthetic
   origin the fold ranks by), the real signing author key, the timestamp (the interpreter's
   BindingCandidate already carries it; registration.ts currently drops it — widen the row
   shape; the frozen rail test/gateway/binding-conflicts-refuses.test.ts asserts only
   entities and survives), and the binding delta id.
2. Server: an amber contested-names block on the /admin dashboard rendering that reading. Each
   contender shows lens, entity, origin, author, timestamp, and the delta id AS TEXT — the
   admin members list renders delta ids as plain text today, and no delta-addressed view
   exists to link to; linking is explicitly out of scope (the delta detail view is its own
   later ticket). No contests, no block.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) With a declared conflicts policy and a root-vs-root contest, the gateway reading names
    both contenders with origin, author, timestamp, and delta id. Verify: new test in
    test/gateway/binding-contested-visibility.test.ts (new file — binding-conflicts-refuses
    is frozen).
(b) With a root-vs-channel contest (a blessed pool row contesting a root registration under
    conflicts), the reading names both — the fold no longer discards the contest. Verify:
    same file, federation-style fixture.
(c) /admin shows the contested name with each contender's origin, author, and timestamp;
    with no contests the block is absent (two-sided). Verify: new test
    test/server/admin-contested-names.test.ts using the session fixture.
(d) The rendered block matches the gateway reading for the same store — the surface never
    disagrees with the resolver. Verify: same server test, asserting page content against a
    direct gateway call.

Merge tier: the gateway half extends a §47 reading (repair of a promised statement); the
surface half is visibility. Self-merges on the ordinary bar; if review finds the fold change
widens behavior rather than retaining it, stack the PR and say so.
title: Contested names made visible — retain the contest in the fold, then render it
